description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed the Deputy Ministers with effect from. 21st November 2024.
categorisation: This gazette contains both the names of specific individuals (e.g., Hon. Anthonige Anil Jayantha Fernando, M.P.) and detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities (e.g., Deputy Minister of Economic Development, Deputy Minister of Agriculture and Livestock, etc.). The content clearly outlines both "who" is being appointed and "what" specific government portfolios they are responsible for, meeting the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
